card.name: Drug preparation and handling instructions
card.fires_on: Words and word parts inside drug preparation, dilution and handling instructions, such as a word in the middle of a drug name or an adjective before a preparation noun. Examples are 'inspired', 'single-dose', 'dispersed in the' and 'fine particles'.
